propositions: ChatGPT sessions in connector-limited environments lack local clone, Gerrit access, shell network access, or mounted Rebar tracker despite having GitHub connector and repository visibility.
Current agent guidance does not explain how to recognize connector-limited environments, which operations remain safe, or when ticket creation cannot be completed natively.

The fallback payload for reviewable tickets must conform to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and optional parent_id, where ticket_id is an agent-generated UUID4 that becomes source_id on import.
Rebar import is the only sanctioned exceptional ingest path; it accepts NDJSON conforming to the fallback schema, assigns fresh local ids and HLC timestamps, and is idempotent by source_id.

In rebar import --dry-run mode, records missing ticket_id or ticket_type are silently dropped with no warning and no counter increment; malformed records are detectable by comparing would_create + skipped against total record count.
Native ticket creation is impossible only when tracker worktree is inaccessible AND (network/remote is inaccessible OR native rebar/rebar-mcp binary is unavailable).
